name: Claude Code
description: Claude Code session supervisor — routes permissions and notifications to iPhone

tools.name: permission_request
tools.description: Routes a Claude Code tool permission prompt to iPhone for approval. Blocks until the user approves or denies.

tools.name: question
tools.description: Routes a multi-choice question from Claude Code to iPhone. Blocks until the user selects an option.

tools.name: session_active
tools.description: Registers or updates a Claude Code session. Called by the PostToolUse hook after each tool execution.

tools.name: notification
tools.description: Pushes a transient alert to iPhone — used for Claude Code status updates and completions.

tools.name: chat_prompt
tools.description: Shows Claude's current input prompt on iPhone so the user can respond from the session block.

tools.name: session_stop
tools.description: Marks a Claude Code session as stopped and removes it from the active session list.
